# Appendix C: Full Heterogeneity Results {.unnumbered}

::: {.callout-important}
This appendix has been reset for rewrite.

The earlier heterogeneity tables in this file were based on the
invalidated pre-fix velocity narrative and are no longer presented as
active manuscript evidence. Regenerated subgroup tables and figures will
be restored only after they are rerun from the cleaned quarter-based
pipeline and reconciled with the current diagnostics.
:::

## Current Working Position

The manuscript now treats heterogeneity as exploratory rather than
confirmatory. The active documentation baseline is:

- overall time-varying velocity effects are null or near-null
- phase-specific effects are not currently trusted as main findings
- any remaining subgroup signals require rerun tables and careful
  uncertainty framing before they can be discussed in the paper

## Planned Rebuild

When this appendix is rebuilt, it should contain only corrected outputs
for:

- phase-specific models based on unique quarters
- subgroup analyses that match the cleaned survival diagnostics
- any trajectory or clustering analysis that survives methodological audit
- robustness tables that correspond to the canonical standardized workflow

Until then, `doc/PROJECT_STATUS.md` remains the authoritative summary of
the project's current analytical position.
